# La Petite Roots

> Play group to Senior KG and day care, with Montessori-trained teachers and a celebration for every season.

Website: https://lapetiteroots.com/

## Contact
- La Petite Roots · 114, VGP Selva Nagar Extension 1, 'Hil Harmony', Velachery, Chennai 600 042 · Less than ½ km from Vijaya Nagar bus stand · +91 91761 06699 · +91 99627 05599 · info@lapetiteroots.com

## Key facts
- founded in August 2015
- 4 preschool programmes
- 10 after-school activities

## Facilities
- Play Group (1.5–2.5 yrs)
- Pre-KG (2.5–3.5 yrs)
- Junior KG (3.5–4.5 yrs)
- Senior KG (4.5–5.5 yrs)
- Day care
- Classical & western dance
- Keyboard, guitar & vocal
- Karate, yoga & silambam
- Hindi & handwriting
- Air-conditioned classrooms
- Safe outdoor playground
- Shuttle service
- Library for kids
- 24-hour CCTV

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is La Petite Roots?
114, VGP Selva Nagar Extension 1, 'Hil Harmony', Velachery, Chennai 600 042 (Less than ½ km from Vijaya Nagar bus stand).

### What facilities does La Petite Roots have?
Play Group (1.5–2.5 yrs), Pre-KG (2.5–3.5 yrs), Junior KG (3.5–4.5 yrs), Senior KG (4.5–5.5 yrs), Day care, Classical & western dance, Keyboard, guitar & vocal, Karate, yoga & silambam, Hindi & handwriting, Air-conditioned classrooms, Safe outdoor playground, Shuttle service, Library for kids, 24-hour CCTV.

### What ages do you take?
Play group from 1.5 years through Senior KG (4.5–5.5 years), plus day care.

### Are there after-school activities?
Yes: classical and western dance, keyboard, guitar and vocal, karate, yoga and silambam, Hindi and handwriting.

### Do you offer transport?
Yes, a shuttle service from your doorstep to the school.

### How do I visit La Petite Roots?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 91761 06699.
